items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he owned the theatre and he hired me as musical director.

ctx.x: But he owned the Apollo Theatre.

Yeah, he owned the theatre and he hired me as musical director. All I had to do was take the music that they brought in and orchestrate it and rehearse the girls with the producer, rehearse the show girls or the dancing girls.
And you tell them what you did there, Tom, because I did some of those things with you, with Eddie South back in 1933, it was down in the basement, wasn't it. You tell it.
